extraction.name: MATHVISTA
extraction.description: MATHVISTA : EVALUATING MATHEMATICAL REASONING OF FOUNDATION MODELS IN VISUAL CONTEXTS
extraction.creator: Pan Lu, Hritik Bansal, Tony Xia, Jiacheng Liu, Chunyuan Li, Hannaneh Hajishirzi, Hao Cheng, Kai-Wei Chang, Michel Galley, Jianfeng Gao
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The MATHVISTA dataset was collected from 28 existing multimodal datasets involving mathematics and 3 newly created datasets (IQTest, FunctionQA, and PaperQA). The collection process involved reviewing over 70 datasets, collecting 19 of them that contain math-related instances and are publicly available. Annotations such as solutions, programs, parsing results, and grounded theorems are also collected, providing demonstration examples for LLMs.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Document analysis, Manual Human Curator, Software Collection, Web Scraping, Web API
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The dataset consists of 6,141 examples, derived from 28 existing multimodal datasets involving mathematics and 3 newly created datasets.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: To ensure data quality, all questions were manually annotated by graduate students in STEM fields and further refined through a rigorous review process. To ensure consistency in annotation, a two-step process was employed. Initially, each dataset was independently annotated by three reviewers, resulting in a high inter-annotation consistency rate of 99.2%.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Fine-grained metadata facilitates a comprehensive analysis of models' reasoning capabilities across various aspects. To this end, we annotate the examples in MATHVISTA with information including question type, answer type, task category, grade level, visual context, and required reasoning skills.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: One limitation is the dataset coverage. While MATHVISTA encompasses a broad spectrum of tasks and visual contexts, there may be gaps in the representation of certain types of mathematical problems and visuals.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Dataset use cases include Training, Testing, Validation, and Fine Tuning.
